product.name: Unique PDF
product.fullName: Unique PDF: Offline PDF Editor – AI Summary, Merge, Compress & Sign
platforms: Google Chrome (Manifest V3, version 120+; AI Summary needs desktop Chrome 138+)
product.positioning: Free PDF tools — now with on-device AI Summary — without subscriptions, watermarks or file uploads.

descriptions.short: Edit, merge, split & compress PDFs, convert JPG to PDF, sign, protect, redact and get AI summaries on-device. Nothing is uploaded.
descriptions.long: Unique PDF is a free PDF toolkit for Chrome that works entirely on your computer. Summarize long PDFs into key points with AI Summary, written on your device by Chrome's built-in AI. Merge and split documents, reorder, rotate and delete pages, compress large files, turn images into PDFs and PDFs into images, add text, drawings, signatures, watermarks and page numbers, protect files with AES-256 passwords, remove passwords you know, edit metadata, and permanently redact sensitive information with automatic verification. Your files are never uploaded: processing happens in your browser, it works offline, and there are no accounts, quotas, subscriptions, watermarks or ads.

coreFeatures.name: AI Summary
coreFeatures.summary: Key points, TL;DR, teaser or headline written on your device by Chrome's built-in AI (Gemini Nano); long documents summarised in parts; labelled non-AI quick summary where the model isn't available.

coreFeatures.name: Split PDF
coreFeatures.summary: Every page, custom ranges, equal parts or at chosen pages; ZIP download.

coreFeatures.name: Organize pages
coreFeatures.summary: Reorder, rotate and delete pages from several PDFs in one workspace.

coreFeatures.name: Rotate, reorder, delete and extract pages
coreFeatures.summary: Visual thumbnail tools with multi-select and keyboard support.

coreFeatures.name: Compress PDF
coreFeatures.summary: Optimises images and removes unused data while keeping text searchable; optional maximum compression.

coreFeatures.name: Images to PDF
coreFeatures.summary: JPEG, PNG, WebP, GIF, BMP and AVIF with page size, orientation and margin controls.

coreFeatures.name: PDF to images
coreFeatures.summary: PNG or JPEG up to 600 DPI.

coreFeatures.name: Edit PDF
coreFeatures.summary: Add text, freehand drawings, highlights, shapes, arrows and images with undo/redo.

coreFeatures.name: Sign PDF

coreFeatures.name: Watermark

coreFeatures.name: Page numbers

coreFeatures.summary: View, edit or remove document properties.

comparisonPositioning.$comment: Describe differences factually; do not name or disparage specific competitors, and do not claim to be the best.
comparisonPositioning.versusOnlineConverters: Many online PDF services upload documents to their servers for processing. Unique PDF processes files locally, so documents are never transmitted.
comparisonPositioning.versusFreemiumTools: Freemium tools often limit daily tasks, file sizes or add watermarks unless you subscribe. Unique PDF's tools have no quotas, watermarks or paid tiers.
comparisonPositioning.versusDesktopSuites: Full desktop PDF suites offer more advanced features (such as editing existing text or OCR) but require installation and often a licence. Unique PDF covers everyday tasks instantly in the browser at no cost.
honestLimitations: Does not edit text that already exists in a PDF (adds content on top).
No OCR or Office document conversion yet.
Visual signatures only; no certificate-based digital signing yet.
AI Summary needs Chrome's on-device model (desktop Chrome 138+ with enough disk space and memory); elsewhere a non-AI key-sentence summary is offered.

faq.a: Yes. All tools are free with no subscriptions, quotas or watermarks.
No. Files are processed on your device inside the browser. The extension's security policy blocks network connections.

faq.q: How does AI Summary work without uploading my PDF?
faq.a: It uses the AI model built into Chrome (Gemini Nano), which runs on your computer. The text is extracted from the PDF on your device and summarised there; nothing is sent to a server. Chrome downloads the model once on first use.

faq.q: Why does AI Summary say it isn't available?
faq.a: Chrome's built-in AI needs desktop Chrome 138 or newer, about 22 GB of free disk space and a capable GPU or 16 GB of RAM. On other devices you can use the Quick summary, which picks key sentences from the document without AI.
Yes. After installation every tool works without an internet connection.
No account or sign-in is needed.

faq.q: Can I edit existing text in a PDF?
faq.a: Not yet. You can add text, drawings, shapes, images and signatures on top of pages, or cover text with a white rectangle and type over it.
Yes. Redacted pages are rebuilt without the original content, and the result is checked automatically to confirm no text remains in the redacted areas.

faq.q: Can it remove a password I forgot?
faq.a: No. Unique PDF only removes protection when you provide the correct password; it never cracks or bypasses passwords.
Files up to 1 GB are accepted. The practical limit depends on your computer's memory; very large files can be slow.
Only your settings and, if enabled, a list of recent file names and sizes, kept in your browser. You can clear it any time.

faq.q: Which languages can I type in the editor?
faq.a: Added text uses the standard PDF fonts, which support Western European characters. Support for more scripts is on the roadmap.
